payload.summary: callModel converts a valibot schema to JSON Schema for Anthropic structured outputs, then validates the reply with valibot again
rationale: Structured outputs accept anyOf but not oneOf, which valibot variant emits; toJsonSchema overrideSchema renames oneOf to anyOf node by node
The $schema draft marker is dropped because the API has no use for it
consequences: Model and effort are constants in src/config.ts, not environment variables
